stem: A pesticide container has a damaged label and the use directions cannot be read completely. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Quarantine or otherwise control the container and obtain the current complete label through an approved source before deciding whether it can be used
Guess the directions from a similar product
Use the remaining visible rate information only
Transfer the product into an unlabeled container and continue
rationale: A worker should not improvise product use when required labeling information is incomplete; the current complete instructions must be available and verified.
